application: Open Surgeries & Endoscopic Surgeries, Monopolar Cautery, ENT and Plastic Surgery
about: Long lasting. Made of Precious Metals. Versatile and Ergonomic.
use: Can be used efficiently to coagulate in complicated parts like the interiors of the abdominal cavity, pelvis and deep in the vagina. Any tissue or any vessel of 10 mm or more in diameter can be safely coagulated and divided for Open as well as Endoscopic Surgery. Various models are made available for varied procedures.
description: This is a break through invention in Electro Surgery. Any tissue or any vessel of 10 millimeter or more in diameter can be effectively and safely coagulated and divided for Open as well as Endoscopic Surgery. Burned or charred tissue will not stick to the tip of the forceps. Different models are made available.  The model shown in the picture is the most versatile and ergonomic one. Because of this special shape of the forceps, it can be used for coagulation in difficult areas like the insides of the abdominal cavity, pelvis, deep in the vagina etc. This is made of precious metal, auto cleavable and last for life time and can be used with any bipolar machine.
name: PANICKER’S SUPER BIPOLAR FORCEPS

application: Caesarian Hysterectomy, Abdominal Hysterectomy, Cervical Encerclage and Non Descent Vaginal Hysterectomy.
about: A 60 degree curve introduced to the regular right angle forceps
use: Can be used as a thread carrier to isolate and tie big vessels in deep areas. The thread can be taken out once the tip is turned after the thread is passed behind the vessel. Can also be used as a tissue separator, tissue retractor and aneurysm needle.
description: This is a modification of right angled forceps. A 60 degree curve has been introduced behind the 90 degree curve of the right angled forceps. The ergonomics, handling efficiency and utility of this instrument has increased many times by this modification. This forceps can be used as a thread carrier to isolate and tie big vessels in very deep areas. This is very useful in emergency situations to tie bleeding vessels and for Caesarian Hysterectomy in PPH without blood loss. This instrument can be used as aneurysm needle for doing Cervical Encerclage, Abdominal Hysterectomy and Non Descent Vaginal Hysterectomy. This is useful for all the surgeons.
name: PANICKER’S UNIVERSAL LIGATION FORCEPS

application: LAVH, Non Descent Vaginal Hysterectomy, Mini Lap Hysterectomy and Orthopedic Surgery
about: Ergonomically designed blade and handle for effective utilization
use: Used in Morsulating Big Fibroids In Intra Abdomen, Coring and Morsulating Big Fibroids In Non Descent Vaginal Hysterectomy, Trim and Shape Ligaments, Cartilages, Bones and Joints
description: When a No.22 blade   is inserted into this VP handle, the blade becomes unbreakable. When the hard tissues like fibroid, cartilage etc are divided the blade can break and the broken pieces can be lost in the tissue or abdominal cavity. This has happened to many surgeons. So as a permanent solution for such mishaps this safety knife has been invented. The handle is ergonomically made for a firm grip for different uses. Straight and angled models available.
name: PANICKER’S UN BREAKABLE SAFETY KNIFE [VP Handle Knife]

about: Offers optimal flexibility, strength and durability for uterine evacuation and curettage
use: Used after a spontaneous abortion or early miscarriage in order to ensure that no fetal tissue remains inside the uterus. If there is excess bleeding, the cannulla can be retained and negative pressure is to be maintained for 20 – 30 mnts.  Also used to stop bleeding in AUB abortions.
description: This cannulla is used for removal of Intra Uterine Polyps. This cannulla is inserted into the uterine cavity and connected to suction and a negative pressure of 400mm HG is produced. Then the cannulla is rotated clockwise and anticlockwise for a few times. This will result in radical curettage and suction of the uterine cavity.
name: PANICKER’S RADICAL D&C CANNULA

application: Pelvic and Vaginal Examination and Surgeries, Vaginal Hysterectomy, Suturing Episiotomy, Vaginal and Cervical Tears and to pack Vagina and Uterus in PPH.
about: One sided speculum with an attached screw, where in a fiber optic light cable can be attached.
use: Can be used for any procedure requiring access and illumination of the Vaginal Cavity. It can also be used as Abdominal Retractor with light to see deep.
description: This is like a one sided vaginal speculum on which a screwing device is attached. A fiber optic light cable can be directly attached to this screwing device. This can be used as a lighted vaginal speculum in vaginal surgeries, vaginal hysterectomy and suturing episiotomy, suturing vaginal and cervical tears. This can also be used as abdominal retractor with light to see clearly deep and difficult areas.
name: PANICKER’S LIGHTED VAGINAL SPECULUM

about: 25 cm long and 12 mm diameter SS cannulla with multiple holes of 4 mm diameter in a distance of 12 cm [Total of 48 Holes]
use: The cannulla is inserted into the post partum uterus to prevent and treat PPH. Negative pressure is applied and the uterine cavity wall is sucked in through the small cannulla holes thereafter closing the bleedings. After 30 mnts the suction is released and the cannulla is slightly rotated and taken out.
description: This is a 25 cm long and 12 mm diameter SS cannulla with multiple holes of 4 mm diameter at the distal 12 cm [total 48 holes]. The cannulla is inserted into the post partum uterus to prevent and treat PPH. After introducing the cannulla 700 mm of negative pressure is applied. The wall of the uterine cavity is strongly sucked into the small holes of the cannulla there by closing all the bleeding sinusoids and arterioles due to pressure effect of suction. Because the wall of the uterine cavity is strongly sucked and held by the cannulla the uterus cannot expand and relax even in atonic PPH. The negative suction pressure is maintained for 30 minutes so that the clotting occurs in these small vessels and bleeding is permanently stopped. After 30 minutes the suction is released and the cannulla is slightly rotated and taken out. This is a very simple and safe break through invention to prevent and treat PPH with absolute success and connect to a suction machine and works even in DIC. This can be used during Caesarian section also.
name: PANICKER’S PPH SUCTION HAEMOSTATIC CANNULA

application: Emergency situations to tie bleeding vessels and for caesarian hysterectomy in PPH
about: A 60 degree curve has been introduced behind the regular 90 degree right angle forceps. Ergonomic, Efficient Handling etc.
use: This is to hold and pull hard tissues. This forceps is also used as a thread carrier to isolate and tie big vessels in very deep areas
description: This forceps is to hold and pull hard tissues like ligaments, cartilages, fibroids etc. The teeth of the forceps are aligned like the alignment of our teeth i.e. the lower jaw is inside the upper jaw. So the bite of this forceps will not slip. Very useful to pull and remove fibroid pieces when big fibroids are morcellated
name: PANICKER’S NON SLIP BULL DOG FORCEPS

application: Accelerate cervical ripening and induction of labor
about: Made of silicon, this is a conical tubular device with 8 cm in length and 3 cm in diameter at one end and1 cm in diameter at the other end-to which a stainless steel tube in 4 cm length with aside hole is fitted.
use: The folly's catheter can be passed through this device first and then into the cervical canal to reach above internal OS. Then the bulb is inflated with 60 ml of saline. The folly's catheter can be passed through this device first and then into the cervical canal to reach above internal OS. Then the bulb is inflated with 80ml of saline.
description: This is a soft autoclavable, reusable specially made silicon device. This is a conical tubular device with 8 cm in length, 3 cm in diameter at one end and 1 cm in diameter at the other end to which a stainless steel tube in 4 cm length with a side hole is fitted. The Foleys catheter is introduced through this device and then passed through the cervical canal to reach the uterine cavity. The bulb of the Foleys catheter is inflated with 60 ml of saline and pulled down against the hole of the device and fixed to the slit on the side. The cervix is sandwiched between the Foleys bulb and the device under pressure. This pressure will enable rapid ripening and dilatation of the cervix. This cervical ripening device can be used as an adapter for PPH Suction Cannulla and MR Cannulla. It is very useful to dilate cervix in previous caesarian cases.
name: PANICKER’S RAPID CERVICAL RIPENING DEVICE

about: Control blood loss and reduce mortality
use: Can be used to hold vessels or vascular pedicle for coagulation or tying open as well as non descent Vaginal Hysterectomy.
description: This is to hold the vessels or vascular pedicle for coagulation or tying in open as well as non descent vaginal hysterectomy. The vascular pedicle can be held with the forceps, coagulated and divided. The coagulated tip of the vessel can be further coagulated and the forceps is released slowly.
name: PANICKER’S VASCULAR / PEDICLE CLAMP

about: A screwing device with a short and broad screwing portion with a T shaped handle which is heavy and long. One limb of the device is with hole into which a thread can be attached. During Laparoscopy the screw can be screwed in to the abdominal wall 3 cm above the pubic nymphs is after making a nick in the skin. The screw will remain beneath the rectus sheath.
use: Can be used as a starter lift followed by insertion of the abdominal lift. The abdominal lift is elevated to establish a Pneumoperitoneum at or near ambient air pressure.
description: This is specially designed screwing device with a short and broad screwing portion with a T-shaped handle which is heavy and long. One limb of the T is with a hole into which a thread can be attached. During laparoscopy the screw can be screwed into the abdominal wall 3cm above the pubic symphysis after making a nick in the skin. The screw will remain beneath the rectus sheath. The thread can be tied to the right angled bar fixed on the table. This will lift the abdominal wall. Because of the heavy handle the screw will not back rotate and slip.
name: PANICKER’S LAPAROLIFT SCREW FOR GASSLESS LAPAROSCOPY

about: Useful when the cervix is dilated 1 cm or more with triple or tetra foleys induction.
use: Foley introducer is a must for precise and easy placement of foleys. Used in a large number of cases both primi gravid and multi gravid. There is no pain or discomfort and induction is almost successful within 6 to 12 hours.
description: This device is useful when the cervix is dilated 1 cm or more. Three foleys or four foleys can be used, ie; triple foleys and tetra foleys induction. Foley introducer is a must for precise and easy placement of foleys. Used in large number of cases both primi gravid and multi gravid. There is no pain or discomfort to the patient and induction is almost successful within 6 to 12 hours. Always apply xylocaine jelly into the vagina to avoid discomfort. For Tetrafoley induction use number 12 foley with a thinner introducer.
name: LOTUS DEVICE FOR INDUCTION OF LABOUR

application: Prevention and Treatment of Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH)
about: Dedicated leakproof equipment producing negative pressure up to 700 mm Hg for 100% success.
use: The PPH cannula is introduced into the uterine cavity up to the fundus. Negative pressure up to 700 mm can be produced by using manual pump or connecting to electrical suction.
description: The PPH treating system is designed and patented by Dr. Panicker recently. The PPH cannula can be introduced into the uterine cavity up to the fundus. Negative pressure up to 700 mm can be produced by using the manual pump or connecting to electrical suction. Because this is a dedicated leakproof equipment, negative pressure can be maintained for a very long time and it gives hundred percent success. This equipment can be used when transferring the patient without disturbing the negative pressure. So useful in shifting the patient with the device to major centre if necessary. Somebody must always watch the pressure gauge and make sure that the negative pressure is maintained.
name: Dr. PANICKER'S PPH TREATING DEVICE

application: Perineal Support and Protection during Vaginal Delivery
about: Precise and hygienic perineal support device (Patent pending) to prevent tears and infections.
use: Support with the P-3 device must be done with the thenar eminence (heel of the palm) and not with the fingers to give proper perineal support.
description: By using this device proper perineal support can be given precisely and hygienically during vaginal delivery. So that vaginal injuries and perineal tears and infections could be prevented. The support with the P-3 device must be done with the thenar eminence (heel of the palm) and not with the fingers. Let us change, Let us improve, Let us be safe and avoid complications and litigations.
name: P-3. DEVICE (Dr. Panickers Perineal Protection Device)

about: Only for induction of labour. Facilitates comfortable and precise placement of foley catheter.
use: Inserted into the foley catheter up to 3cm below the tip. Introduced into the cervical canal without catching the cervix with vulsellum or allis forceps.
description: This introducer can be inserted into the foley catheter. The tip of the introducer will reach up to 3cms below the tip of the foley catheter. With this introducer, the catheter can be introduced into the cervical canal very comfortably and precisely even without catching the cervix with vulsellum or allis forceps. After introducing the tip of the foley into the cervical canal, withdraw the introducer 3cms and further introduce the foleys, so as to pass the bulb of the foley beyond the internal OS. The tip of the foley will bend and accommodate in the extra amniotic space. Now inflate the foley bulb and then withdraw the introducer completely. The introducer is very useful and can be used along with Cervical Ripening Device also. Thinner model is available to use with number 12 foley.
name: PANICKER'S FOLEY CATHETER INTRODUCER

application: Cerclage and Complete Devascularization Suturing of the Uterus
about: Aneurysm needle replacement for PUL forceps in complete uterine devascularization.
use: Can be used as an aneurysm needle to do cerclage and in most situations where PUL forceps is used.
description: This can be used as an aneurysm needle to do cerclage. This is used for complete devascularization suturing of the uterus instead of PUL forceps. PUL Needle can be used in most of the situations where PUL forceps is used.
name: PANICKER'S UNIVERSAL LIGATION NEEDLE (PUL)

about: Nonslip Allis forceps with shifted box joint and 1" / 1.5" tip length.
use: Gives a strong nonslip grip when holding tissue so the tissue will not slip off.
description: This is specially made Allis forceps. When a tissue is held with this Allis, the tissue will not slip off. The box joint is shifted to the distal 1/6th and length of the tip is 1" and 1 1/2" respectively. This change is making this forceps giving a strong grip and making it nonslip. Use this Allis and experience the difference.
name: NON SLIP ALLIS 8" (Long and short)

application: Cervical Dilatation for Surgical and Diagnostic Procedures
about: Recent innovation to dilate the cervix safely and efficiently up to 15mm or more.
use: Useful for procedures like curettage, removal of polyps, fibroids, IUD, uterine manipulator insertion, hysteroscope, and endometrial ablation.
description: This instrument is my recent innovation to dilate the cervix safely – much more superior than all the instruments and gadgets used to dilate the cervix at present. Introduce the tip of the dilator into the cervical canal (under anesthesia, after assessing the length and direction of the cervical canal using a uterine sound) and press gently the body of the dilator and rotate. The tip of the dilator will expand and when rotated the cervix will get dilated even up to 15mm or more. Useful for all procedures like curettage, removal of polyps, fibroids, IUD, to introduce uterine manipulator, hysteroscope, endometrial ablation device etc; when dilating more than 1cm, infiltrate 5ml adrenaline saline into the cervix to prevent any bleeding.
name: PANICKER'S NEW RAPID CERVIX DILATOR

application: Prevention and Treatment of Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH)
about: Single-use sterile, lubricated PPH suction cannula with connecting silicon tube.
use: Used for immediate uterine suction and haemostasis during postpartum hemorrhage management.
description: Single use sterile, lubricated Panicker's PPH suction cannula with connecting silicon tube. Designed for safe, efficient, and hygienic prevention and treatment of Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH).
name: Single use sterile, lubricated Panicker's PPH suction cannula with connecting silicon tube
